metric_lineage.equation: sum actual observed months; supported unit-months / 12 for robot-year equivalents
metric_lineage.inputs: calendar_bridge.months and enterprise.months

metric_lineage.equation: delivered human zones * baseline hours per zone * (1 - current digital efficiency)
metric_lineage.inputs: actual human delivery, selected cell and calendar-year digital path

metric_lineage.equation: floor(scheduled staff cents / (100 * wage per hour * baseline hours per zone * (1 - digital efficiency)))

metric_lineage.basis: fixed paid staffing; conservative whole-zone capacity

metric_lineage.equation: sum settled uniquely identified supplier invoices; fees are included once in enterprise outlay
metric_lineage.inputs: annual robot/site rates divided by 12, actual support, declared upgrade price
metric_lineage.basis: synthetic resource bills, exact cents and disclosed rounding

metric_lineage.equation: commit vintage and resource usage only after physical, rent, software and upgrade bookings all settle
metric_lineage.inputs: explicit qualification price/hours, shared support allocation and existing cohort vintage
metric_lineage.basis: assumed qualification contract, not real model rights or field validation

metric_lineage.equation: monthly support + upgrade hours <= allocated support; commissioning integration hours <= allocated integration; each allocation * 12 <= annual pool
metric_lineage.inputs: annual budgets and declared monthly shares
metric_lineage.basis: one monthly market allocation; other annual markets are not simultaneously executed
